europe_now.title: Protests and Unrest in France and Germany
europe_now.summary: Demonstrations spanning multiple cities in France drew hundreds of thousands of participants amid heightened security concerns. Meanwhile, protests in Germany over the cost of living escalated into violent clashes and localized looting.

europe_now.title: Polish Constitutional Court Crisis
europe_now.summary: Poland faced a deepening rule-of-law crisis after the nation's president became physically involved in a direct confrontation with judges at the constitutional court during an ongoing power struggle.

top_stories.title: Ukrainian Evacuations from Occupied Territories
top_stories.summary: Civilians displaced from Russian-occupied front-line areas in Ukraine completed harrowing journeys to rejoin their families. These evacuees shared testimonies detailing severe deprivation during years spent under occupation.

top_stories.title: European Stance on Russia and Diplomacy
top_stories.summary: European officials expressed strong opposition toward any potential international return for Vladimir Putin. Leaders warned that reintegrating Russian leadership risks normalizing ongoing war crimes on the continent.

europe_now.title: Widespread French Demonstrations and Security Response
europe_now.summary: Hundreds of thousands of demonstrators took part in protests across France during a weekend marked by heightened security measures and clashes with authorities. Interior ministry officials reported an estimated 320,000 participants as major cities braced for potential disorder.

europe_now.title: Polish Constitutional Court Power Struggle
europe_now.summary: A deepening rule-of-law crisis in Poland escalated as the president entered the constitutional court amid an ongoing institutional power struggle. Judges and officials faced physical confrontations as tensions surrounding the judiciary reached a critical point.

top_stories.title: Evacuation of Ukrainian Civilians from Occupied Territories
top_stories.summary: Civilians evacuated from the Russian-occupied frontline city of Oleshky have arrived back in Ukraine after enduring years of severe conditions. Families shared emotional reunions with loved ones following the successful humanitarian operation.

top_stories.title: Unrest and Looting During German Protests
top_stories.summary: Demonstrations regarding the cost of living in Germany turned violent as protesters clashed with law enforcement agencies. Authorities reported that several shops were looted during the escalating civil unrest.

europe_now.title: Mass protests across France enter third week with clashes in Paris
europe_now.summary: Over 320,000 demonstrators participated in largely peaceful protests across France, while clashes erupted between police and protesters in Paris. The French interior minister warned of high risk of disorder as the movement continues.

europe_now.title: Polish president confronts judges in constitutional court power struggle
europe_now.summary: Poland's president physically entered the constitutional court amid a rule-of-law dispute, prompting protests outside the building. The confrontation escalates a long-standing conflict over judicial independence.

top_stories.title: French protest movement sustains momentum with widespread demonstrations
top_stories.summary: Hundreds of thousands of people have marched across France for a third consecutive weekend, with the interior ministry reporting 320,000 participants. Clashes broke out in Paris as authorities warned of heightened risks during Halloween demonstrations.

top_stories.title: Polish constitutional crisis deepens as president clashes with judges
top_stories.summary: Poland's president entered the constitutional court building amid a power struggle with judges, leading to a physical confrontation. Protesters gathered outside the court as the dispute over judicial appointments intensifies.

top_stories.title: Ukrainian civilians evacuated from Russian-occupied Oleshky reunite with families
top_stories.summary: Ukrainian civilians evacuated from the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky have reunited with family members after years of isolation. Residents described surviving on weeds and enduring harsh conditions before their departure.

top_stories.title: German cost-of-living protests turn violent with looting reported
top_stories.summary: Protests over rising living costs in Germany turned violent, resulting in looting of shops and clashes with police. The demonstrations reflect growing public anger over inflation and economic pressures.

top_stories.title: EU warns against normalizing Russia at G20 as ministers remain divided
top_stories.summary: EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas warned that Vladimir Putin's potential attendance at the G20 would normalize Russian war crimes. G20 ministers remain divided over Russia's presence, highlighting diplomatic tensions.
